case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

You wrote that you take pride in supplying us with castings from our region, and we want a fair, lasting arrangement for both family companies. We have looked closely at your offer, and Option A below is the package we can approve.

On the notice period:
Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.

On quality:
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Volute casing HN 50-200 with you were placed at EUR 128.42 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011493-10), EUR 128.27 on 2025-06-03 (po:4500012541-10), EUR 126.53 on 2026-01-16 (po:4500013434-10) and EUR 126.53 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014428-10): the price has not risen.

Given these points, Option A gives your foundry a clear, firm price from the new date and prompt payment.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 125.45; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 126.17; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 126.89; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Beyond the options, there are things that cost us nothing and that we gladly offer. We will act as a reference customer for your other clients, share our rolling forecast with you every quarter, approve your invoices within days of receipt, and name you a preferred supplier for this part family.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. Building on your Option A, we accept the delayed effective date of 1 April 2027 and the 30-day payment terms. To accommodate this significant delay in implementation, we propose a revised unit price of EUR 136.50. 

For our Angebot, we quote a price of €136.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

You said the delay in the effective date is significant for you, and we have taken that seriously. You have accepted the later start and the payment terms, and we thank you for that and for checking the notice period point so carefully.

Option A below is the package we can approve. It gives your shop a clear start date and a payment term you can plan with, and we will pay every invoice on its agreed due date.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 136.49; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. We would like to settle this with you directly, as one family company with another.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your constructive approach and the significant step towards our position. As one family company to another, we value this direct and fair settlement. We can accept your terms and await your order. We accept your proposed package at EUR 136.49 with the 1 April 2027 start date and 30-day payment terms. For our Angebot, this means a price of €136.49 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
